title: Set up the project
body: Clone the repository, run the project locally and write the steps in the README.

title: Agree how the team works
body: Agree how you will split work, review pull requests and run your meetings. Write the agreement in the README.

title: Build a small feature
body: Pick a small piece of the brief, build it on a branch and open a pull request that closes this ticket.

title: Fix a bug
body: Find a bug, write a test that shows it, fix it and open a pull request that closes this ticket.

title: Review a teammate's pull request
body: Review a pull request from a teammate. Leave at least one useful comment.
